title: Component contract
description: A machine-readable contract for a bioinformatics component (tool/db/data type/workflow). Declares preconditions, operating range, and must-not-use boundaries so a fit-critic can reject a workflow that would RUN but be WRONG. This is the enforceable core the workbook prose ymls lack.

version.description: Version this contract is scoped to. Contracts are version-scoped: a gotcha true for 0.12.x may be false for 0.11.x.

interface.description: Inputs/outputs and formats — the 'Interface' contract section.

preconditions.description: Assertable conditions the input must satisfy. Each `assert` is a restricted boolean expression over the fact namespace (declared.*, measured.*). Evaluated by shared/contracts_lib.py — NOT python eval.

operating_range.description: Validated operating range. Numeric bounds are advisory (warn) unless also encoded as a precondition.

must_not_use.description: Off-label boundaries — the key gap the STAR scorecard flagged. Prose boundaries the judgment harness checks the requested DELIVERABLE against.

boundary.description: What the tool must NOT be used for.

keywords.description: Deliverable keywords that likely trip this boundary (cheap deterministic pre-filter before any LLM check).

failure_modes.description: Known hard failures with a detection SIGNAL the diagnosis harness greps stderr/stdout for, plus a known fix.

signal.description: Substring/regex found in stderr/stdout when this failure occurs.

expectations_ref.description: Relative path (from the contracts/ root) to the expected-range table the results-evaluation harness scores output against.
